summary: Implemented `in` membership for rdflib namespaces. In rdflib/namespace.py, Namespace.__contains__ returns ref.startswith(self) (prefix test, reference as receiver). ClosedNamespace.__contains__ returns True only when ref equals a stored term URI under node-type-aware equality, so Literals and plain strings are rejected and container properties like rdf _1 are False; _RDFNamespace inherits it. The _ipython_key_completions_ hook now returns dir(str(self.uri)) per the spec's literal wording; revert to dir(self) if term names were intended. In test/test_namespace.py I added prefix, SH, RDFS closed, and RDF closed tests using assertTrue/assertFalse with messages and no namespace-plus-string concatenation. Nothing was run: tests and doctests are unverified, per the instruction not to run repository code. No commits were made.
